_comment: PostCraft queue. Copy this to posts.json, then add entries to "posts". The queue starts EMPTY on purpose - see _examples below for a worked sample of every post type, and copy the one you need into "posts". Run: node schedule.cjs --list
_when: LOCAL wall-clock time, 24h, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. Every scheduler uses the browser's own timezone, so if your audience is elsewhere, convert first. Minutes must be 00/15/30/45.
_types: text | image | images | document (LinkedIn PDF) | video

_examples.caption:
A text-only post. No media needed.

Keep the hook on the first line - that is all most people read.

Put any link in the FIRST REPLY, never in the post body: a URL here costs 40-70% of your distribution.
Up to 4 images on X, 10 on Instagram, 20 on LinkedIn.

_examples.documentTitle: Shown as the title above a LinkedIn PDF carousel
_examples.caption: LinkedIn documents are PDFs. Build one with assets/build_assets.cjs.
9:16 video. Instagram routes this to Reels automatically - the feed composer refuses anything taller than 4:5.
The same file cross-posts to X, Instagram and TikTok. One entry per platform, caption written natively for each. TikTok allows 4000 characters.
